_comment: Numerical defaults for the GP baseline. Only the 'model' and 'early_stopping' blocks are read by the code (models/gp/_constants.py); the rest documents the reference implementation's defaults and is NOT what the paper used. The GP settings behind the published numbers are models/gp/train.py:DEFAULT_CFG (paper Table 3).

kernel._comment_rf_init: sta = RF center from natural images STA (smoothed argmax). ground_truth = from white noise/checkerboard ellipse fits (datasets/rf_centers_ground_truth.npz). center = image center (0,0).

early_stopping._comment_es_metric: Only 'elbo' or 'none' are valid: under the interleaved F-step the transient in A makes val_ll / val_r / val_rho too noisy to stop on.

data._comment_n_val_split: 0 = no validation carving; ELBO-based early stopping does not need val data. Set >0 to enable diagnostic val_log_lik / val_r / val_rho curves, which are NOT used for early stopping.

active_learning._comment: Settings of the authors' closed-loop experiments, kept for reference. Nothing in this repository reads them.
active_learning._comment_checkpoint_pool_sum_tolerance: Integrity-check tolerance compared against X_pool.sum() to catch wrong-dataset bugs. The pipeline derives it from the pool instead (cirf.data.gp_pool_tolerance); this value is the fixed fallback the reference implementation used.
